title: Nobody Sees Your Group Costume Through Tinted Glass
why: October pattern-interrupt for unaware bachelorette and birthday planners comparing party buses: your costume needs an audience, and only open air gives it one.
hook_options: You planned matching costumes. Then booked tinted windows.
Halloween in New Orleans happens on the sidewalk.
The party bus hides the best part of your outfit.
caption: Your group spent three weeks on matching costumes. Don't hide them behind tinted windows. On the bike bar the street is the audience: people wave, film, and yell from the sidewalk. Bring your playlist, bring the outfits, let New Orleans look. Send this to whoever's planning. #neworleans #nolabachelorette #halloweeninnola #nola

slides.headline: Nobody sees your costume through tinted glass
You planned the outfits for three weeks
slides.body: Matching wigs. Sashes. The group chat argued about colors. Then somebody booked a party bus.

slides.headline: A sealed box has no audience
slides.body: Tinted windows, rows of seats, a speaker only you can hear. Your costume rides in the dark.

slides.headline: No windows. No walls. No roof over your outfit.
slides.body: The bike bar is open air. The street sees exactly what you wore.

slides.headline: Strangers wave. People film. Some try to climb on.
slides.body: That reaction from the sidewalk is half the ride. You can't get it from inside a limo.

slides.headline: Your song, out loud, on the street
slides.body: The one the bride picked. The sidewalk hears it too. Sometimes the sidewalk sings back.

slides.headline: Lights on. Costumes on. City on.
slides.body: Your captain knows which blocks are alive tonight and which corners get the loudest reaction.

slides.headline: Irish Channel or Mid-City
slides.body: Two routes, both open air, both rolling past real New Orleans houses, not a parking lot loop.

slides.headline: Open air. Your music. A street that reacts.
slides.body: If the costume took three weeks, give it more than a window.

slides.kicker: Save this for the group chat
slides.headline: Let New Orleans see the costume
slides.body: 21 and up. Book the ride at nolabikebar.com and send this to the planner.
